# Notices

`pia-wgservice.exe` combines code from the following MIT-licensed projects:

- `amnezia-vpn/amneziawg-windows`, including the Windows tunnel service,
  configuration parser, firewall integration, network watcher, and ring logger.
- `amnezia-vpn/amneziawg-go`, including the AmneziaWG userspace engine and
  Windows UAPI implementation.
- `WireGuard/wintun-go`, including the Wintun userspace binding.
- `pia-foss/desktop-wireguard`, from which the PIA-compatible command-line
  contract and interface maintenance behavior were derived.

The PIA wrapper modifications are Copyright (C) 2026 Private Internet Access
contributors and are released under the MIT License. Preserve the upstream
license files and source-file copyright notices when redistributing this binary.
